scope: Numerical source/tests, selected16 real inputs, original selected SF/CA guards, all new predictions, full selected FEDS vectors and rasters, logs. Annual archives, venv, PPO weights and real holdout maps excluded.

simfire.scope: Unpacked source and selected inputs, existing pinned dependencies; one technical replay, no new evaluation sample or fresh install.

ca.scope: Unpacked source and selected inputs, existing modern dependencies; first-case technical replay, no full second evaluation or fresh install.

restore.limits: First-case fresh SF plus all3 CA replicas, all5 masks per replay; all80 observations rebuilt. Existing dependencies, not a fresh install or full second simulator evaluation.
